approaches.name: Brute Force - Linear Scan
approaches.description: Scan every element left to right and return the index the moment target is found. Simple but doesn't use the fact that the array is sorted.

approaches.name: Optimal - Binary Search
approaches.description: Since the array is sorted, repeatedly halve the search space. Compare the middle element to target and discard the half that can't contain it.

approaches.name: Optimal - Binary Search (lower bound)
approaches.description: Standard binary search, but instead of returning -1 on failure, return 'lo' — the index where target would be inserted to keep the array sorted.
